_comment: UCP agent profile for this stock monitor. Mattel's robots.txt points
automated clients at their UCP/MCP endpoint, and that endpoint requires
meta['ucp-agent'].profile to be a URI it can fetch. This is that document.
It is served from the monitor's own GitHub Pages site.
Deliberately declares no payment_handlers and no checkout capability:
this agent reads catalogue data for one collector's personal stock
notifications and must never transact. Keep it that way.
name: ari-hw-monitor
description: Personal Hot Wheels restock monitor. Read-only catalogue lookups; never carts, checkouts or orders.
